cues: Opens with a "Check first: do you need a new tool?" section weighing an existing alternative (ExifTool one-liner) before planning, suggesting a deliberate scoping step
Explicit Goals and Non-goals sections and a closing "Questions to settle before building" list, a structured, checklist-like template
Thorough risk and edge-case treatment (two-pass rename, crash-safe log written before pass 2, case-only renames, UTC in QuickTime, zero dates), which goes beyond a typical unstructured plan
Technology options table with pros and cons and a recommendation, plus a numbered milestone and testing section, so the output is highly uniform
Polished and numbered throughout with no conversational filler; this could also be a strong default output, which keeps my confidence moderate
